[SWS_LOG_00250] Implementation of DltMessage
⌈
For each DltMes-
sage, the modeled message header file shall contain the following DltMessage vari-
able definition in the same namespace:
constexpr static <DltMessageName>Type <DltMessageName>;
where:
<DltMessageName> is DltMessage.shortName.
<DltMessageName>Type is an implementation-defined data type for DltMessage.
⌋
